dialogues.speaker: Sevigne
dialogues.text: They were successfully recovered after the fact. It sure took a lot of effort to transport them.

dialogues.speaker: Sevigne
dialogues.text: After the inspection, we found both prototypes needed to be scrapped. They hadn't been maintained for a long time, plus...

dialogues.speaker: Sevigne
dialogues.text: Oh, I didn't mean to blame you. Mr. Maillardet has some new toys now and has completely forgotten about the prototypes.

dialogues.speaker: Sevigne
dialogues.text: He even delegated the recovery and inspection work. I had hoped I would have a chance to meet him, but it looks like I'll need to find an opportunity to visit Erinnyes for that...
